positioning.rule: /global competes independently: commercial, commercial-investigation and informational keywords (including rental head terms) are valid targets on their merits; never yield or route rankings to another domain, never copy another site's content, never edit another domain. Purely transactional (book/pay-now) topics stay out (forbidden_intents) because /global cannot fulfil them.

targets.note: Planning ceiling, not a quota to fill. Homepage, About, Contact, Privacy, Terms and utilities never count.

architecture_rule: All 8 domains are open for research. A RESEARCH_OPEN domain with no existing Hub accepts candidates using parent_id:null, domain_id and its proposed-Hub subcluster as ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKED in the topical map. Such candidates are not Matrix IDEA, Writer claims or publishable URLs. To create a Hub: reviewed architecture PR plus at least 8 distinct validated Supporting candidates, and existing Matrix/SEO/URL safeguards.
